karty.priklad: Enillodd hi fedal aur i Gymru.
karty.priklad_cs: She won a gold medal for Wales (medal → [f]edal as the object after enillodd hi; Cymru → [G]ymru after i).
karty.mnemo: A MEDAL on a red ribbon, glowing red-hot from the forge.

extra.pozn: medal aur / arian / efydd = gold / silver / bronze medal (aur, arian, efydd begin with a vowel, so they don't change after the feminine medal); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r fenter newydd yn helpu pobl i ddysgu Cymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: The new initiative is helping people learn Welsh (menter → [f]enter after y, feminine; dysgu → [dd]ysgu after i).
karty.mnemo: A MENTOR (MENTER) launches a risky new venture, fizzing like a Bonfire Night sparkler.

extra.pozn: mentro = to venture, to dare (L9), mentrus = enterprising (L7); Menter Iaith = local organisation promoting Welsh (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Faint o fedalau enillodd seiclwyr Cymru ym Mhencampwriaethau'r Byd ddoe?
karty.priklad_cs: How many medals did the Welsh cyclists win at the World Championships yesterday? (medalau → [f]edalau after o; Pencampwriaethau → [Mh]encampwriaethau after ym)
karty.mnemo: pen (head, top) + campwr (champ; camp = feat, L7): the top champs battle for a cup studded with rubies.

extra.pozn: pencampwr = champion (outside the coursebook); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 212

karty.priklad: Dw i'n teithio mwy ar drafnidiaeth gyhoeddus.
karty.priklad_cs: I travel more by public transport (trafnidiaeth → [d]rafnidiaeth after ar; cyhoeddus → [g]yhoeddus after the feminine noun).
karty.mnemo: TRAF- as in TRAFfic: a fire engine stuck in rush-hour traffic, siren wailing.

extra.pozn: trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus = public transport; sentence from Siaradwch – Byw yn wyrdd, p. 202

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi newid ei harferion bwyta.
karty.priklad_cs: She has changed her eating habits (arferion → [h]arferion after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: fel arfer = as usual: what you do as usual is your habit. A penguin waddles to the same ice floe every single morning.

extra.pozn: arferol = usual, anarferol = unusual (L15); ro'n i'n arfer… = I used to…; ei = her adds h before a vowel; own example

karty.priklad: Dyma ganlyniadau'r arolwg ar ailgylchu.
karty.priklad_cs: Here are the results of the survey on recycling (canlyniadau → [g]anlyniadau after dyma).
karty.mnemo: A ROLL-call (AROL-wg) of opinions: a surveyor with a clipboard, ticking boxes in a blizzard.

extra.pozn: arolygydd = inspector (L12); canlyniad = result (L15); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n dioddef o flinder ers misoedd.
karty.priklad_cs: She has been suffering from tiredness for months (blinder → [f]linder after o).
karty.mnemo: wedi blino = tired → blinder. So tired you're snow-BLIND (BLIND-er).

extra.pozn: blinedig = tired, tiring (L3); wedi blino'n lân = completely exhausted (L14); dioddef = to suffer (L9); own example

karty.priklad: Prynais i fylbiau i'r ardd.
karty.priklad_cs: I bought bulbs for the garden (bylbiau → [f]ylbiau as the object after prynais i; gardd → ardd, g drops after i'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: BULB (BYLB): a cold blue bulb glowing inside an igloo.

extra.pozn: sentence based on the presents game, p. 206 (bylbiau i'r ardd)

karty.priklad: Pwy fydd yn gadeirydd y pwyllgor eleni?
karty.priklad_cs: Who will be the chair of the committee this year? (cadeirydd → [g]adeirydd after yn)
karty.mnemo: cadair (chair) + -ydd (person): the one who sits on the throne of ice at the head of the table.

extra.pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman; cadeirio = to chair (L13), pwyllgor = committee (L4); Dewiswch y cadeirydd (p. 210); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n tyfu llysiau heb gemegau.
karty.priklad_cs: I grow vegetables without chemicals (cemegau → [g]emegau after heb).
karty.mnemo: cemeg = chemistry: a blue liquid in a test tube kept in the freezer.

extra.pozn: cemegyn = one chemical; usually the plural cemegau; cemeg = chemistry (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y distawrwydd ar ben y mynydd yn braf.
karty.priklad_cs: The silence on top of the mountain was lovely.
karty.mnemo: distaw = quiet: the dead silence of a glacier at night.

extra.pozn: distaw = quiet (outside the Geirfa); own example

karty.priklad: Mae fy ffrind i'n dod o Ddyffryn Conwy.
karty.priklad_cs: My friend comes from the Conwy Valley (Dyffryn → [Dd]yffryn after o).
karty.mnemo: A valley carved by a glacier, an ice-blue river at the bottom; Dyffryn is common in place names.

extra.pozn: cwm = narrower valley (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Edrychwch ar y treigladau a dewiswch yr esboniad o'r blwch.
karty.priklad_cs: Look at the mutations and choose the explanation from the box.
karty.mnemo: "Let me explain over an ESPresso (ESB-oniad)" – an iced one.

extra.pozn: esbonio = to explain (outside the Geirfa), synonym egluro (L16); sentence from Ymarfer – Egluro, p. 209

sever.priklad: Sbiwch ar y treigladau a dewiswch yr esboniad o'r blwch.
sever.priklad_cs: Look at the mutations and choose the explanation from the box.
sever.pozn: north: sbio instead of edrych meaning to look (L18)

karty.priklad: Mae'r roced yn mynd i'r gofod fory.
karty.priklad_cs: The rocket is going into space tomorrow.
karty.mnemo: GO FOrwarD (GOFOD): onwards into the freezing dark of space.

extra.pozn: gofodwr = astronaut (outside the coursebook); roced = rocket (L15); fory = colloquial yfory; own example

karty.priklad: Cerddon ni at yr hen oleudy.
karty.priklad_cs: We walked to the old lighthouse (goleudy → oleudy, g drops after hen).
karty.mnemo: golau (light) + tŷ (house) = the house of light above a frozen sea.

extra.pozn: plural like tŷ → tai; own example

karty.priklad: Mae pêl-droed yn obsesiwn yn ein tŷ ni.
karty.priklad_cs: Football is an obsession in our house.
karty.mnemo: OBSESSION (OBSESIWN): it grips you like frostbite.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y palmant yn llithrig iawn bore 'ma.
karty.priklad_cs: The pavement was very slippery this morning.
karty.mnemo: An ANT slides under a PALM tree on a frozen pavement: PALM-ANT.

extra.pozn: llithrig = slippery (L3); own example

karty.priklad: Siaradodd un streiciwr â'r wasg.
karty.priklad_cs: One striker spoke to the press (gwasg → [w]asg after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: streic (strike) + -iwr (person): a striker on the picket line in a blizzard.

extra.pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman; striker = person on strike, not a football forward; y wasg = the press (L15); own example

karty.priklad: Ces i doriad gwallt ddoe.
karty.priklad_cs: I had a haircut yesterday (toriad → [d]oriad as the object after ces i).
karty.mnemo: torri = to cut, to break → toriad. Scissors straight out of the freezer, ice-cold.

extra.pozn: toriad gwallt = haircut; toriad trydan = power cut; toriadau = budget cuts; own example

sever.priklad_cs: I had a haircut yesterday (toriad → [d]oriad as the object after ges i).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Mae treiglad meddal ar ôl y gair 'i'.
karty.priklad_cs: There is a soft mutation after the word 'i'.
karty.mnemo: TREIGLad ~ TRIangle: a triangle carved in blue ice, one corner for each mutation – meddal, trwynol, llaes.

extra.pozn: treiglad meddal / trwynol / llaes = soft / nasal / aspirate mutation (table p. 209); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r undeb wedi galw streic arall.
karty.priklad_cs: The union has called another strike.
karty.mnemo: un (one) + -deb: all as one, like penguins huddled together against the cold.

extra.pozn: undeb llafur = trade union; yr Undeb Ewropeaidd = the EU (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.cs_upresneni: power from a power station, not personal get-up-and-go
karty.priklad: Dw i'n defnyddio ynni gwyrdd o baneli solar.
karty.priklad_cs: I use green energy from solar panels (paneli → [b]aneli after o).
karty.mnemo: egni = a person's energy (L7), ynni = energy from the socket: a cold blue electric spark.

extra.pozn: based on Siaradwch – Byw yn wyrdd, p. 202 (defnyddio ynni gwyrdd, e.e. paneli solar)
